lines.say: Is fruit sugar bad for you?
Fruit has sugar, mostly fructose and glucose. So some people cut fruit to get lean.
But whole fruit comes with fiber and water. It fills you up, and the sugar enters your blood more slowly.
When health guidelines say cut sugar, they mean added sugar, like sweets and soft drinks, not whole fruit.
Studies link eating more whole fruit to a lower risk of heart disease and type two diabetes.
Juice is different. It's easy to drink a lot of sugar fast. Eat the fruit instead.
Two or three pieces a day fits fine, even when you're cutting.
